# Guildon

The guild's all-in-one helper for World of Warcraft: Forever and Classic Era: professions and recipes of the guild,
wish list with orders, trade and mail help, shared auction prices and profitable crafts, guild members on the map.
Download: https://www.curseforge.com/projects/1770383

The full description (German) is in [README.md](../README.md). Bug reports are welcome as issues,
please add the text of `/gn diag`.
